summary: Constraints on creativity seen through @amyburvall's eyes rhizomatic learning breeds that which creates but keep a machete at the ready blades dripping In constraint Hack at Habitats of habitual wandering Carving paths Of whimsy #smallpoems #mb
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Constraints on
creativity
seen through
@amyburvall's
eyes
rhizomatic learning
breeds that which creates
but keep a machete
at the ready
blades dripping
In
constraint
Hack at
Habitats of
habitual wandering
Carving paths
Of whimsy
#smallpoems #mb
